rate_table_note: Rates are in 365:10-5-64(b)(1) to (4), as published (the joint rates are printed as figures). Source line: "Amended at 10 Ok Reg 3049, eff 10-1-93; ... Amended at 13 Ok Reg 2669, eff 7-1-96; Amended at 14 Ok Reg 2650, eff 7-1-97". The Department's copy was uploaded in 2019; the official code (rules.ok.gov) could not be read by the tool, and the Department's 2020 chapter 10 amendments (posted on its site) changed credit forms and appendices, not this section.
summary: Rates in force: Oklahoma's presumptively reasonable credit life rates in OAC 365:10-5-64: single life $1.05 per month per $1,000 outstanding balance, $.68 per year per $100 decreasing and $1.26 per year per $100 level; joint lives $1.58, $1.02 and $1.89. The section was last amended effective July 1, 1997; whether that amendment changed these figures was not checked. Credit A&H rates (Appendix E) are not in the saved copy.
